page.notes: The page number is printed in old form as "y04" and is read as 904. The running head is printed in small capitals. The bracketed word "[Iesuitici]" is printed in the text in italics and is kept as printed. The short stray mark after "Epist.ad Paulinum." and the marks at the foot of the page, together with the digitiser's stamp at lower right, are not printed text and are left out. The headings XXVIII and XXIX are bare numbers and are therefore written as paragraphs.
